## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her decorated hat before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) become instant friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home happily, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a treat of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to herself that she is becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>

> During class at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Unhappy with the separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her warmly and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sends her a secret note. Over the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) focuses fiercely on her studies and engages in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. > While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. > During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>

> Noticing how plain Anne's clothes are compared to other girls', [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop, but gets so intimidated by the clerk that he ends up buying rakes, seed, and sugar instead. He enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to buy and sew the fashionable brown dress, which he presents to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a snowy Christmas morning alongside a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed by the gifts and goes on to star in the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Christmas concert.
>

> On Christmas morning, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the concert. The evening concert is a huge success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performing wonderfully in her new dress. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss how proud they are of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and consider her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes home to find tea not prepared and learns that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green using dye bought from a peddler. When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off short. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school with her hair shingled, bearing the humiliation as penance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful summer outdoors before returning to her studies, discussing her growing maturity and moral thoughts with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). As the Queen's class prepares for the fateful [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid physical growth and quiet demeanor, sharing her fears of losing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

> After a successful encore and compliment-filled supper, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) head home with [Billy](../character/billy.md). During the ride, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share compliments and express envy of the wealthy hotel guests, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserts her contentment with who she is and the love she has back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
